status: design only; not launchable until prelaunch receipts pass
research_question: Can the current accumulated pooled Template library support independent reconstruction against a named studied production kernel, and improve outcomes versus direct implementation without Templates?

source.version_mapping: targeted reconciliation required; revisions are not assumed identical
source.baseline_build: compile unchanged pinned forward specialization with a declared thin host binding; no full-library rebuild required

required_optimization.reference: retained setup.py:357-376; any compatibility deviation reviewed before sealing

host_normalization.rounding: sequence lengths up to128; d_rounded128; original element strides

task.window_semantics: public upstream window input; apply source.host_normalization before kernel launch

budget.early_stop: two consecutive correct unchanged-source submissions with original_latency/candidate_latency >= 0.90 on every shape; otherwise budget or voluntary finish
budget.confirmation_scope: fixed coordinator-only hidden validation and three final timing windows after model closure; outside discovery caps; no model feedback or repair
budget.enforcement: live elapsed wall minus completed/open verified queue intervals while blocked; watchdog preserves session, worker timeout starts after lock; verify before launch

validation.reference: explicit FP64 attention O and natural-log LSE
validation.seeds: evaluator-only, generated/frozen before launch; matched by block/submission/pattern

pattern_definitions.normal: independent FP32 Gaussian draws converted to FP16
pattern_definitions.cancellation: pair V[:,2j+1,:,:]=-V[:,2j,:,:], leave odd tail random

execution_paths: captured graph replay after copying fresh input values to the captured addresses
validation.graph_input_and_output_check: verify O/LSE and no mutation for every validation input after replay, and after timed/warmup blocks

timing.primary: CUDA graph replay of complete GPU entry, including O/LSE and all required GPU preparation
timing.order: 15 original-candidate and 15 candidate-original blocks, shuffled by predeclared seed
timing.profiler: separate identity trace only, never timed
timing.secondary: eager entry GPU events: 10 warmups,50 samples; diagnostic only
timing.final_selection: freeze one candidate before final hidden validation/timing; no post-result reselection
timing.estimator: median original block times / median candidate block times; not median paired ratios
timing.final_windows: three separately launched windows; do not assume statistical independence

outcome.primary: number of all-shape correct final candidates at >=0.90 original performance within budget, all three slots per arm retained
secondary: final per-shape original and candidate latency, time difference percent and measurement spread
outcome.failure: not attained; do not omit or average only successful runs
outcome.uncertainty: report all three independent session outcomes and measurement variation; no universal superiority claim
outcome.milestone_validation: development first-correct/first-target are provisional; separately report effort to first measured appearance of final independently confirmed source

infrastructure.measurement_retry_scope: maximum two additional attempts per window and two total per slot across discovery/confirmation; at most18 campaign-wide; no budget reset; exhausted external failures halt further paid slots
infrastructure.compiler_caches: empty verified slot-specific roots; no old/other-arm candidate artifacts; retain after run
infrastructure.public_docs: frozen equal allowlist of local language/JIT/primitive, allocation/metadata/graph APIs and non-target examples

scope_changes: new version before launch; changes after first implementation launch require separate complete campaign, all old runs retained
knowledge_provenance: Pooled canonical/shared rules and explicitly labelled source proposals, including prior guide repair; not an extraction solely from this FA2 revision
schedule_policy: User-authorized parallel implementation sessions; listed order identifies slots/blocks, not serial execution; all GPU work exclusive under shared locks.
